extraction.name: Pointer Sentinel Mixture Models
extraction.description: A mixture model for neural sequence models that combines the advantages of standard softmax classifiers with those of a pointer component for effective and efficient language modeling.
extraction.creator: Stephen Merity, Caiming Xiong, James Bradbury, Richard Socher
extraction.publisher: MetaMind - A Salesforce Company, Palo Alto, CA, USA
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The WikiText dataset is constructed from articles extracted from Wikipedia. The dataset is available in two different sizes: WikiText-2 and WikiText-103. Both feature punctuation, original casing, a larger vocabulary, and numbers.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Words with a count below 3 were discarded and replaced with a <unk> token.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Text extracted from Wikipedia using the Wikipedia API.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Tokenization, lowercasing, and removal of punctuation were performed.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A vocabulary was constructed by discarding all words with a count below 3. Words outside of the vocabulary were mapped to the <unk> token.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is freely available for download at the WikiText dataset site.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset allows for the capture and usage of longer term dependencies.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset has a larger vocabulary and more rare words than the Penn Treebank dataset.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The Penn Treebank dataset has limitations, such as limited vocabulary and lack of punctuation.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Language modeling, predicting rare or unseen words
